_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: The McGraw-Hill Companies 'is a leading content and analytics provider serving the capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material impact on our results of operations', with McGraw-Hill Education held for sale and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: The McGraw-Hill Companies 'is a leading content and analytics provider serving the capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material impact on our results of operations', with McGraw-Hill Education held for sale and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 3.64x; +35% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.44; conservative 2yr +3%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -39.1%/yr (worst year FY03-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.2%/yr (Q4 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.4%/yr (FY03-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MHFI (retrospective, 2014-02-05) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.64x (71.4% downside to Bear $22 / +19.6% upside to Bull $92) | Adj composite 1.62 vs market 3.06: gap -1.44 [OVERVALUED] | +35% above the EPP floor $57 (15x FY14E $3.80) | Conservative 2-yr case: +3.0% total (+1.5%/yr) | At 20.2x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $102 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue +2.1% in Q4 2013, forward revenues +2% (no FY14 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2013 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
